mcplite: Lightweight stdio MCP server for R

Source: R/mcplite-package.R
mcplite.Rd

Expose R functions as tools for a local Model Context Protocol (MCP) client. Define tools, save them in a script ending with mcp_server(), and configure the client to launch that script with Rscript --vanilla and an absolute script path. The server blocks until standard input closes.

Define tools and return results

Use mcplite::tool() with the tool-types helpers to describe arguments. Tools remain directly callable R functions. Return ordinary R values for text conversion, or tool_result() with content_text() and other content-blocks constructors for structured or rich output. See mcplite-results for exact return-value mappings and payload JSON options.

Schemas do not validate values or enforce permissions. Tools own domain validation, authorization, safe side effects, and output limits. Keep stdout exclusively for MCP protocol messages; use stderr for diagnostics.

Scope and next steps

mcplite is tools-only and stdio-only; embedded resources and resource links in results do not provide resource endpoints. See mcp_server() for server use, supported protocol versions, and optional tracing. Compatible ellmer::tool() objects are accepted, but ellmer is not required.

Website guides: Get started, Write tools, and Return results.
